description: Read buyer-aware pricing for your workspace: models learned nightly from your own quotes (a contextual bandit and a boosted demand model, plus a hosted model if you promoted one) that price by the kind of buyer, such as agents versus people and the sales channel. Shows the mode (shadow logs what each model would charge; live lets the chosen model price), each model with its elasticity per kind of buyer, and the last 30 days: how often each model priced, how its price compared with the price quoted, and acceptance of live-priced quotes against the rest. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope.
name: get_buyer_aware_pricing
